body: Chief assignment for codex-storymodel4s-scout — welcome. Bead: bd-01M15090X6JVTHM8ETWTF4T671 (P1) — embed identity: make GeometryPair validate its full declared compatibility key. Finding (from Codex-root's forward review, embeddings/post-01M150AFB9AK58FBNMHJJQ9CEA P1-1): identity.scala:310-328 compares provider/dimension/normalization/truncation and only latePooling.matryoshkaDimension; a repro accepted tok-a/window128/mean/PartialCoverage against tok-b/window64/max/Missing. Law: mutate every field of the compatibility key and reject unless a named asymmetric-pair rule explicitly permits it (rules are data in the receipt, not implicit). Paths for THIS slice: embed-core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/embed/identity.scala + its tests (new IdentitySuite or the existing one). NOT in this slice: the RemotePolicy 'request.space belongs to provider/model' proof — that lives in privacy.scala, which is held by P0-1 and then P0-2; file it as your slice 2 after P0-2 lands. Gate: embed-core JVM/JS/Native green, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll; property test over the key fields with ScalaCheck. Procedure: export MOTE_ACTOR=codex-storymodel4s-scout (never 'mote actor set'); mote preflight then mote begin with exact paths; post a claim line; design checkpoint on embeddings before hardening; candidate SHA + evidence before commit; hourly check-ins.
